name: Hometown Diner
tagline: Fresh, local and worth the trip
headline: Good food, made with heart, in Rindge
intro: Hometown Diner is where Rindge comes to eat. Generous portions, familiar faces, and food made the way it should be.
about: Hometown Diner is a locally owned diner in Rindge, New Hampshire. We cook the kind of food people come back for: honest, generous and made from scratch.

Whether it is breakfast with the family, lunch on a work day, or dinner with friends, you will find a warm welcome and a full plate. Thank you to the 1,084 guests who have shared a review. It means the world to a small business.

services.title: Dine in
services.desc: Pull up a chair. Great food and friendly service, every day.

services.title: Take out
services.desc: Call ahead and it will be hot and ready when you arrive.

services.title: Daily specials
services.desc: Ask what is fresh today. The specials board changes with the season.

services.title: Catering & events
services.desc: Feeding a crowd? We handle parties, meetings and family gatherings.

services.title: Family friendly
services.desc: Kids welcome, high chairs ready, and a menu with something for everyone.

services.title: Local ingredients
services.desc: We buy from nearby farms and bakers whenever we can.

whyUs.title: Locally owned
whyUs.desc: A Rindge favorite, run by people who live here.

whyUs.title: Made fresh daily
whyUs.desc: Nothing sits around. Everything is prepared in-house.

reviews.author: Cindy Trainque
reviews.text: Two of stopped by for a late lunch..a simple drive by. Bella was our polite and chherful waitress. We both ordered the Brekfast Bowl. Mine was made special as I am allergic to peppers. Food came quickly and portions were large. We didn't finish our meal as we were quite full. We told Bella that we w I all definitely be back!

reviews.author: Jim Ben
reviews.text: 07/05/2026 - We stopped for a mid-afternoon lunch.  The food was excellent and the portions were generous but not overwhelming.  There were four servers working and as such, service was very efficient.  The server that took care of us has been employed for over 35 years at this establishment - kudos to her!  The facility interior is of a "classic" diner architecture.  We sat at the counter instead of waiting about 20…

reviews.author: Jerry Albert
reviews.text: Authentic 50s era diner. Large food portions and moderately priced. Our server kept the coffee hot and water glasses filled. Seems to be popular with the locals.

reviews.author: Gaby L
reviews.text:
It was very busy when we came in and no one acknowledged us as we waited to be seated.
Ordered the eggs benedict classic, included 2 poached eggs, bacon, avocado, tomato and bacon, grilled english topped with hollandaise sauce and hubby ordered the chicken fried steak and eggs. Also ordered chocolate chip pancakes as well as the banana french toast which was topped off with bananas foster sauce and whipped cream. All…

reviews.author: Olivia Meek
reviews.text: The food was absolutely amazing, the service was great and the old time feel of the diner was fabulous. We would definitely eat here again!
